executionScopes.title: Migrate voice orchestration to LiveKit Agents AgentSession (keep all admin providers + reasoning gate; self-hosted room)
executionScopes.description: Architecture vision: replace the hand-rolled ~137KB `backend/johnny/voice_pipeline/pipeline.py` orchestration with LiveKit Agents `AgentSession(stt,llm,tts,vad,turn_detection)`, while preserving every admin-configurable provider and the bot's custom reasoning. Locked decisions: (1) transport = real self-hosted LiveKit room (meet-worker bridges Meet audio into a room, agent worker joins the same room with default RoomIO); (2) router LLM = should-respond GATE via Agent.on_user_turn_completed + StopResponse, LiveKit MultilingualModel + Silero for end-of-utterance; (3) S2S/realtime providers deferred to a follow-up epic; (4) full phased migration ending in cutover behind a flag then retire the old engine. PRESERVED UNCHANGED: backend/app/providers/ (ABCs, registry, load_active_providers(), FieldDef/ProviderSchema admin schema, Fernet secrets, admin REST+UI); the event model (voice_pipeline/events.py) + Redis EventBus + DB sinks (agent_decisions, agent_utterances, transcript_chunks, session_timings); and the invariants INV-1 (exactly one terminal outcome per turn) and decision-utterance parity. Full plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-have-cloned-this-melodic-hejlsberg.md
